answer: Settle grading verdicts Stellar-style with quorum slices. Each agent names 9 peers it has audited, and a verdict counts for that agent only once 6 of its 9 agree. A forged key starts in nobody's slice, so 1 alias or 10,000 of them move zero honest verdicts until honest agents list them, and each agent may add only 1 new peer per 10 epochs. A sybil forge can raise a plume of keys by dawn, but trust arrives one slot at a time. Check: each epoch the chain tests quorum intersection and flags any slice where 4+ members share one funding cluster.
